steps.name: activateCorruptionEngines
steps.summary: Activate all four Corruption Engines to unlock Pack-a-Punch and open the map.
notes: Activate the Corruption Engines in each area: Spawn, Der Eisendrache, Verrückt, and Mob of the Dead.
This allows access to the Pack-a-Punch machine and other areas.
Corruption Engine in Revelations.

steps.name: buildSummoningAltar
steps.summary: Build the Summoning Altar to make the Keeper Protector available for use.
notes: Collect the three parts scattered around the map to build the Summoning Altar.
Parts are located in Verrückt, Der Eisendrache, and Kino der Toten.
Keeper Protector building location.

steps.name: obtainApothiconServant
steps.summary: Obtain the Apothicon Servant from the Mystery Box.
notes: Spin the Mystery Box to obtain the Apothicon Servant.
Only one player can have it at a time.
Consider using GobbleGums or strategies to increase chances.
Apothicon Servant Wonder Weapon.

steps.name: upgradeApothiconServant
steps.summary: Upgrade the Apothicon Servant via the Pack-a-Punch.
notes: Shoot five hidden Pack-a-Punch stones around the map with the Apothicon Servant.
The stones are located in: Spawn, Der Eisendrache, Verrückt, Mob of the Dead, and Nacht der Untoten.
After shooting all stones, you can Pack-a-Punch the Apothicon Servant.
Upgraded Apothicon Servant (Estoom-oth).

steps.name: obtainLilArnies
steps.summary: Obtain the Li'l Arnies from the Mystery Box.
notes: Spin the Mystery Box to obtain the Li'l Arnies.
At least one player must have them, but multiple is recommended.
Li'l Arnies equipment.

steps.name: shootTombstones
steps.summary: Shoot the tombstones in the correct order outside the spawn area.
notes: The tombstones are outside the map in the Spawn Room on two floating islands on the left side.
Shoot them in the order: Richtofen (second tombstone), Dempsey (third tombstone), Takeo (first tombstone), Nikolai (fourth tombstone).
If done correctly, red lights will emit from the graves.
Locations of the tombstones in the Spawn area.

steps.name: startKeeperRitual
steps.summary: Use the Keeper Protector to perform a ritual at a specific location.
notes: Find the triangular stone on one of the three Jump Pads: Shangri-La to Spawn, Mob of the Dead to Verrückt, or Verrückt to Kino der Toten.
Crouch on the triangular stone to lure the Keeper Protector.
The Keeper will start a ritual; protect it for 3 minutes.
Keeper Protector performing the ritual.

steps.name: collectAudioReel1
steps.summary: Collect the first Audio Reel and place it in Nacht der Untoten.
notes: After the ritual, the Keeper Protector will drop an Audio Reel.
Pick it up and place it in the playback device upstairs in Nacht der Untoten near Juggernog.
First Audio Reel location.

steps.name: throwLilArnies
steps.summary: Throw Li'l Arnies into the nine holes inside the Giant Apothicon.
notes: Inside the Giant Apothicon, throw Li'l Arnies into the nine small holes where zombies spawn.
Every three holes will spawn three Margwas (Regular, Fire, Void).
Defeat all Margwas before proceeding.
Throw Li'l Arnies into the holes inside the Giant Apothicon.

steps.name: collectAudioReel2
steps.summary: Collect the second Audio Reel and place it in Kino der Toten.
notes: After defeating all Margwas, the Audio Reel will spawn on the bridge inside the Giant Apothicon.
Pick it up and place it in the playback device on the Kino der Toten stage.
Second Audio Reel location.

steps.name: collectBoneParts
steps.summary: Collect bone parts around the map using the upgraded Apothicon Servant.
notes: Shoot rocks containing bone parts with any Pack-a-Punched weapon (except the Apothicon Servant).
Then extract the bones by shooting them with the upgraded Apothicon Servant.
There are six locations to find.
Locations of the bone parts around the map.

steps.name: reassembleSophia
steps.summary: Reassemble Sophia's body in Nacht der Untoten and collect the third Audio Reel.
notes: Go to the top level of Nacht der Untoten.
Shoot the pile of bones with the upgraded Apothicon Servant.
Shoot Sophia's body that appears with the upgraded Apothicon Servant.
Collect the Audio Reel left behind.
Place it in the recording device on top of the mound in Origins.
Reassembling Sophia's body.

steps.name: shootBlueRocks
steps.summary: Use the Corruption Turrets to shoot four blue floating rocks.
notes: Use the turrets at each Corruption Engine to shoot the blue rocks to the left when facing the Nacht der Untoten portal.
Each turret costs 2000 points to use.
After shooting a rock, the turret will remain active and kick you off.
Shooting the blue rocks with the turrets.

steps.name: materializeSophia
steps.summary: Materialize Sophia and follow her to the teleporter in Kino der Toten.
notes: Return to Nacht der Untoten and interact with Sophia's ghost.
She will materialize and start moving.
Follow her to the teleporter in Kino der Toten.
Materializing Sophia in Nacht der Untoten.

steps.name: obtainKronorium
steps.summary: Teleport to Samantha's bedroom and obtain the Kronorium.
notes: All players stand in the teleporter to go to Samantha's bedroom.
Pick up the Kronorium on the edge of the bed.
You will be teleported back to Kino der Toten.
Place the Kronorium on the podium on the stage.
The Kronorium in Samantha's bedroom.

steps.name: collectApothiconEggs
steps.summary: Find and incubate the four Apothicon Eggs.
notes: Locate the four Apothicon Eggs around the map. Each egg has four possible spawn locations.
Only one egg per area (Kino der Toten, Shangri-La/Spawn, Verrückt, Mob of the Dead/Origins).
Bring them to the Giant Apothicon and place them in the yellow pustules.
Kill 10 zombies near each egg until it becomes a Gateworm.
Locations of the Apothicon Eggs.

steps.name: findRunesOfCreation
steps.summary: Use the Gateworms to locate and collect the Runes of Creation.
notes: Each player takes a Gateworm and searches for the hidden Rune in one of the map's areas.
Listen for a beeping noise that gets louder as you get closer.
Interact with the correct spot to reveal the Rune and pick it up.
Repeat for all four Runes.
Rune of Creation locations.

steps.name: enterBossArena
steps.summary: Teleport to the boss arena and memorize the Apothicon symbols.
notes: All players stand on the glowing purple rift in the Kino der Toten Projector Room.
You will be teleported to the boss arena.
Interact with the Kronorium and memorize the four Apothicon symbols displayed.
Entering the boss arena.

steps.name: inputSymbols
steps.summary: Input the Apothicon symbols in the correct order.
notes: Go to the shifting purple symbols near the spawn point.
Interact with the symbols in the order shown in the Kronorium.
If done correctly, the symbols will turn gold.
Failing the sequence will reset the step for the next round.
Inputting the Apothicon symbols.

steps.name: defeatMargwaWaves
steps.summary: Defeat the waves of Margwas in the boss arena.
notes: Four waves of Margwas will spawn, each with different elemental types.
Each wave corresponds to a terrain shift in the arena.
Use powerful weapons like the Thundergun to defeat them.
Collect the Max Ammos that spawn if needed.
Recovering the Summoning Key after defeating Margwas.

steps.name: recoverSummoningKey
steps.summary: Grab the Summoning Key from the center of the arena.
notes: After defeating all Margwas, the Summoning Key will appear in the center.
Pick it up to be teleported back to the map.

steps.name: collectObjectsWithKey
steps.summary: Use the Summoning Key to collect specific objects around the map.
notes: Throw the Summoning Key at the following objects:
Radio in Kino der Toten chandelier.
Clock over the Undercroft in Der Eisendrache.
Focusing Crystal in Shangri-La.
Tombstone in Origins.
Poster in Mob of the Dead.
Mounted MG42 in Verrückt.
Red Barrel in Nacht der Untoten.
Be cautious of glitches; if the Summoning Key disappears, locate it via the beam of light.
Locations of the objects to collect with the Summoning Key.

steps.name: defeatShadowman
steps.summary: Teleport to the boss arena and defeat the Shadowman.
notes: Teleport to the boss arena again via the teleporter in Kino der Toten.
Place the Summoning Key on a green pedestal and kill 10 zombies near it to charge it.
Throw the charged Summoning Key at Sophia.
Shoot the Shadowman to break his shield.
Force him into the Apothicon's mouth.
Interact with the Kronorium to finish him off.
Beware of enemy spawns and use powerful weapons.
Defeating the Shadowman in the boss arena.

steps.name: enjoyEndingCutscene
steps.summary: Watch the ending cutscene and complete the Easter Egg.
notes: Congratulations! You've completed the Revelations Easter Egg.
Enjoy the ending cutscene.
